desc.testo: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd. known as Wanhua Chemical and formerly Yantai Wanhua Polyurethane or Yantai Wanhua Polyurethanes or Yantai Wanhua, is a Chinese listed company in chemical industry.
desc.trad: Wanhua Chemical Group Co., Ltd. conosciuta come Wanhua Chemical e precedentemente Yantai Wanhua Polyuranthrope o Yantai Wanhua Polyuranthropes o Yantai Wanhua, è una società cinese quotata nel settore chimico.
